mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% consistently reduces the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 3.0% signals a tightening labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate profit visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.0% (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 105.0 (INDPRO) indicates reduced supply chain bottlenecks that lower input costs and boost corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0 (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0% (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Rising nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) above its 3-month moving average indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 3-month moving average (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in employment (PAYEMS) signals a rapidly tightening labor market that increases consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (based on 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above its 3-month moving average indicates expanding manufacturing output and supply chain efficiency that reduces input costs and increases corporate margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 3-month moving average (based on 10-year rolling window).
